content.text:
The drawing shows a TMS group (trimethylsilyl) joined to one end of a carbon–carbon triple bond. The other end of the triple bond carries CO2Me (a methyl ester).

Expanding the abbreviations gives Si(CH3)3–C≡C–C(=O)OCH3, which is methyl 3-(trimethylsilyl)propiolate.

SMILES: C[Si](C)(C)C#CC(=O)OC
